rubix.description: Runs all six face sequences through a selected synthesized drum, mallet, plucked-string or 303 bank. Uncovered screen area mixes each sticker live, including ringing tails; hidden stickers are silent and master compression tames dense mixes.
rubix.start: Turn on Audio and Play, choose a bank, then orbit or twist the cube to bring different sounds into view. Visibility dynamics defaults to proportional screen area; Classic and low-latency SIMD 303 both follow the visible surface.

additions.description: A rotatable 3D Graph Synth with directed note propagation, true spatial edge timing, height/depth/radius/bend pitch mappings, and bounded spring, repulsion, center, and shell forces.
additions.start: Enable Audio and Play. Drag empty space to orbit, drag a node to reshape it, or Shift-drag into depth. Enable forces to hear the geometry reorganize.

additions.description: Records a line onto a one-sided tape band and plays it against its own transform, with a draggable seam, twist parity that doubles the period, and a cut whose result is the real topology.
additions.start: Turn on audio, press Record and make a sound, then drag the seam and change the involution.

additions.description: A grid of detuned resonators with a disorder control that has a threshold: below it a strike floods the lattice, above it energy stays trapped where it entered.
additions.start: Turn on audio, strike a cell, then sweep Disorder across the measured threshold and strike again.

additions.description: Sends a recorded phrase through a chamber of draggable scatterers until it is unrecognisable, then replays it time-reversed so it reconverges on a movable focus.
additions.start: Turn on audio, record a phrase, play it scattered, then reverse it and move a scatterer to hear the refocus degrade.

additions.description: Two coupled resonators with balanced gain and loss whose partials converge and coalesce at an exceptional point, where the response to a fixed perturbation grows as a square root.
additions.start: Turn on audio, strike or record into it, then raise the gain and loss balance slowly and listen for the two partials merging.

additions.description: One continuous tape loop with independently positioned play, record and erase heads, where defeating the erase turns the same machine from a delay into a looper.
additions.start: Turn on audio, click the ring to add a head, then drag it around for position and in and out for level.

additions.description: Divides one intact recording into segments with draggable splice markers and optional chords, measuring the real order period rather than asserting it.
additions.start: Turn on audio, click the ring to add a splice, then shift-click two splices to connect them with a chord.

additions.description: Segments a phrase into families and proposes a transition graph, showing the measured order period so a collapse is visible before the graph is accepted.
additions.start: Turn on audio, press Play, then move Distinctness and watch families split or merge before accepting the graph.

additions.description: A graph whose edges facilitate and deplete like synapses, so each one is band-pass in pulse rate and tempo decides which paths carry signal.
additions.start: Turn on audio, press Play, then sweep Pulse rate from 1 to 12 and watch the signal move between ring steps and shortcuts.
